memory_candidates.content: Extending a closed status/verdict enum in the orchestrate pipeline requires clearing every gate UPSTREAM of the consumer switch, not just adding the consumer arm. Base-mode research/plan/implement dispatches write no handoff, so orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh recovers dispatch_status from .return-meta.json via orchestrate-recover-outcome.sh, whose `case "$status"` accepts only researched|planned|implemented and sends everything else to an exit-1 STATUS_NOT_SUCCESS arm. validate-return-meta.sh independently holds a closed valid_statuses array. A new status value that is only added to the postflight switch never arrives there: recovery fails first, dispatch_status stays empty, and the empty value hits the off-schema catch-all that sets halt=true and records an OFF_SCHEMA_STATUS defect. Before adding any new status or verdict value, enumerate the pipeline gates with `grep -rn 'researched|planned|implemented' agent-system/extensions/` and admit the value at every one, upstream-first.
